errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the main organizing principle of the chart, which is "Възможност за избор на работно място" (Possibility to choose a workplace), divided into two sub-charts: "НЕ" (No) and "ДА" (Yes). It only mentions the comparison between working from home and from the office.

errors.text_span: Стълбата, отбелязваща „От вкъщи“, достига височина от около 25, докато стълбата, отбелязваща „От офис“, достига височина от около 40.
errors.evidence: The chart consists of two separate panels, each containing two bars. The description incorrectly treats it as a single chart with only two bars in total, conflating the data from the two distinct conditions ('No choice' and 'Yes, choice').
The y-axis is labeled "Ниво на мотивация" (Level of motivation), not "Ниво на вкръзи".

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност е 10, а най-високата е 40.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies axis labels (10 and 40) as the lowest and highest data values. The actual lowest bar value is approximately 18, and the highest is approximately 41.
The description incorrectly states that both bars are blue. In reality, the chart shows two green bars in the left panel and two blue bars in the right panel.
